title: IFEP: Integrated Fast Evolutionary Programming - Automated Material Identification
description: IFEP (Integrated Fast Evolutionary Programming) is MATLAB research software for automated identification of material parameters in nonlinear constitutive models. It implements an integrated self-adaptive and multi-strategy evolutionary programming framework for fast automated material identification of creep damage constitutive models.
